evidence.scope: root consensus only; no EVM, no aggregator shard; real manager over a verified history: starts, reports follower, stages, refuses vote/timeout/proposal signatures, promoted after install, removed validator becomes a follower

evidence.label: REAL-PROCESS
evidence.step: no root of the weighted epoch reports itself a follower (#515 membership gate)
evidence.scope: A: all four roots are members of the weighted epoch; none reports follower, so the membership gate is in the signing path and admits every member; REAL-PROCESS root + EVM + three aggregator shards (F8), fresh-B1 stack, roots through the q4shim build; crash model SIGKILL over the retained home (not a power loss)

gaps.label: REAL-PROCESS (non-member)
gaps.reason: No non-member or removed-validator root runs in this lane (all four roots stay committee members): the follower signing nothing and catching up on a real network needs the P85 slice 7 joiner run or an A to B removal handoff.
gaps.blockedBy: slice 7 joiner run / removal handoff lane
